about: The epistola of the formulary “Saint Thomas the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: You are no longer strangers and newcomers, but you are fellow citizens of the saints, and you belong to the household of God, built up on the foundation of the apostles and of the prophets, Christ Jesus Himself being the chief cornerstone; in whom the whole building, put together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord; in whom you also are built up together into a habitation of God in the Spirit.

a.g: with Christ Jesus Himself as the chief cornerstone

ex.w021: This phrase identifies Christ Jesus as the cornerstone of the building. Latin leaves the verb ‘to be’ unexpressed. ‘With … as …’ conveys that relationship in English.
